channel.title: LLM Infra Notes
channel.description: Practical notes on running LLMs on rented GPUs: VRAM sizing, batching, vector stores, and what actually breaks in production.

item.title: Why Your GPU Sits at 30% While Serving Requests
item.description: Low utilisation is usually an unbatched workload, not an underpowered card

item.title: RAG: Should the Vector Store Live on the Model Host?
item.description: The decision is about RAM, not VRAM — and the two failure modes look identical from the outside

item.title: How Much VRAM Does an LLM Actually Need?
item.description: A sizing method you can recompute for any model — and the reason your weights are usually not what ran out of memory
